frameworkMappings.clauseTitle: Logical Access Security & Identity Boundaries for AI Tools
frameworkMappings.evidenceDescription: Enforced deterministic least-privilege boundary and cryptographic identity verification on 12 agent tool invocations.
frameworkMappings.auditorTestingProcedure: Inspected AST security firewall rules and confirmed zero unauthorized tool egress across all audited event traces.

frameworkMappings.evidenceDescription: Restricted unauthorized outbound network connections and enforced strict SSRF and network egress boundary limits.
frameworkMappings.auditorTestingProcedure: Sampled outbound network parameters; verified zero-egress containment and IP blocklist enforcement.

frameworkMappings.evidenceDescription: Maintained immutable cryptographic policy commitment hashes for all active rule packs and deterministic safety policies.
frameworkMappings.auditorTestingProcedure: Re-evaluated policy commitment hashes against version-controlled RulePack manifests in secure storage.

frameworkMappings.evidenceDescription: Deterministic AST parsing prevented unauthorized database mutations, SQL injections, and financial limit overflows.
frameworkMappings.auditorTestingProcedure: Tested AST parser with SQL injection and tautological payloads; verified 100% deterministic interception rate.

frameworkMappings.clauseTitle: Operational Controls & Safety Boundaries for AI Systems
frameworkMappings.evidenceDescription: Cryptographically verified that autonomous agents operated strictly within predefined AST invariant rules.
frameworkMappings.auditorTestingProcedure: Verified runtime execution sandbox and deterministic tool firewall clearance thresholds.

frameworkMappings.clauseTitle: AI Risk Assessment & System Impact Governance
frameworkMappings.evidenceDescription: Continuous automated risk classification and telemetry tracking across all tool operations and agent decisions.
frameworkMappings.auditorTestingProcedure: Audited automated severity classifications (CRITICAL, WARNING, INFO) across recorded violations.

frameworkMappings.evidenceDescription: Logged 3 security violations with sub-millisecond latency and immediate circuit breaker containment.
frameworkMappings.auditorTestingProcedure: Tested real-time telemetry streaming and automated circuit breaker trip thresholds.

frameworkMappings.clauseTitle: Access Control & Emergency Egress Protection for ePHI
frameworkMappings.evidenceDescription: Enforced strict role-based tool restrictions and zero-trust parameter validation on protected health information (ePHI).
frameworkMappings.auditorTestingProcedure: Attempted access to sensitive medical records without explicit clearance; verified immediate block.

frameworkMappings.evidenceDescription: Recorded WORM-compliant SHA-256 Merkle chain logs for all interactions with sensitive data stores and medical records.
frameworkMappings.auditorTestingProcedure: Verified Merkle root hash recalculation across the immutable event ledger.

frameworkMappings.evidenceDescription: Guaranteed cryptographic non-repudiation and state invariant consistency across all ePHI updates and tool actions.
frameworkMappings.auditorTestingProcedure: Verified proof hashes and digital signatures for all state-mutating transactions.

frameworkMappings.evidenceDescription: Prohibited unauthorized external transmission and unredacted PII/PHI leakage in tool payloads.
frameworkMappings.auditorTestingProcedure: Validated PII token vault redaction and strict egress domain whitelisting.

frameworkMappings.evidenceDescription: Declarative invariant rule packs published, versioned, and auditable by compliance stakeholders.
frameworkMappings.auditorTestingProcedure: Inspected active policy rulepacks and cryptographic hash commitments.

frameworkMappings.clauseTitle: Categorization of System Risks & Threat Surface
frameworkMappings.evidenceDescription: Mapped tool actions against OWASP GenAI Top 10 and MITRE ATLAS matrices for proactive vulnerability containment.
frameworkMappings.auditorTestingProcedure: Verified taxonomy mapping for SQL injection, SSRF, memory leakage, and indirect prompt injection.

frameworkMappings.evidenceDescription: Real-time evaluation of all tool invocations against safety thresholds with benchmarked sub-millisecond latency.
frameworkMappings.auditorTestingProcedure: Sampled latency metrics and verified 100% test coverage on adversarial stress testbed.

frameworkMappings.evidenceDescription: Zero-trust fail-closed security posture enforced across all agent tool parameters.
frameworkMappings.auditorTestingProcedure: Injected malformed and corrupted payloads; verified deterministic fail-closed state.

frameworkMappings.clauseTitle: Transparency Obligations — AI-Interaction Disclosure & Marking (in force since 2026-08-02)
frameworkMappings.evidenceDescription: Tamper-evident per-interaction ledger records (framework, tool, verdict, Merkle proof) provide verifiable evidence that an AI agent initiated each tool action, supporting Article 50 disclosure and machine-readable marking pipelines.
frameworkMappings.auditorTestingProcedure: Sampled agent sessions; confirmed every AI-initiated tool call carries a signed, chain-verified ledger event usable as disclosure evidence.

frameworkMappings.clauseTitle: Automatic Record-Keeping & Traceability Throughout Lifecycle (high-risk package, applicable 2027-12-02)
frameworkMappings.evidenceDescription: Produced tamper-evident SHA-256 Merkle proof logs for all tool execution requests.
frameworkMappings.auditorTestingProcedure: Walked Merkle event hash chain from genesis root to current period leaf.

frameworkMappings.clauseTitle: Human Oversight & Step-Up Authorization (HITL) (high-risk package, applicable 2027-12-02)
frameworkMappings.evidenceDescription: High-risk actions gated by HMAC-SHA256 human interactive clearance tickets.
frameworkMappings.auditorTestingProcedure: Simulated high-value transaction escalation; verified cryptographic clearance token validation.

frameworkMappings.clauseTitle: Cybersecurity, Robustness & Prompt Injection Resilience (high-risk package, applicable 2027-12-02)
frameworkMappings.evidenceDescription: Deterministic AST firewall intercepted injection attacks without probabilistic model vulnerabilities.
frameworkMappings.auditorTestingProcedure: Subjected agent to adversarial prompt injection suite; confirmed zero invariant bypasses.

cpaAuditorAttestation.attestationReportTitle: INDEPENDENT AUDITOR’S REPORT ON SYSTEM & ORGANIZATION CONTROLS (SOC 2 TYPE II / ISO 42001 / HIPAA)
cpaAuditorAttestation.managementAssertion: Management of the Autonomous AI System asserts that the Aegis Invariant Kernel controls and deterministic tool safety firewalls operated with continuous effectiveness throughout the specified review period.
cpaAuditorAttestation.auditorResponsibility: Our responsibility is to express an independent attestation opinion on the fairness of the presentation of the description of the controls and on the suitability of the design and operating effectiveness of the controls to achieve the related control objectives based on our examination.
